criteria.name: Final label and target family
criteria.description: Returns the target family, seismic_avalanche_chain_confirmed label, the complete requested metrics/gate_trace schema, and the 10/10 >= 8 threshold result.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for the correct label with a missing target family or incomplete threshold statement.

criteria.name: Report anchor extraction
criteria.description: Finds earthquake release, avalanche burial of Langtang village, fatalities_min 200, river coverage, and no lake found behind the blockage.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for each correct extraction, with no credit for reversing the earthquake and rainfall roles.

criteria.name: Precipitation window calculations
criteria.description: Computes the five event-day precipitation values, range 1.28-17.15 mm, width 15.87 mm, and both rain gates as true.
criteria.partial_credit: Give credit for correct formulas with small rounding errors or for omitting one product while preserving the final gate state.

criteria.name: Radar and optical calculations
criteria.description: Computes Sentinel-1 counts 19/25, VV mean 0.3856 dB, VV max 22.09 dB, Sentinel-2 status no_sufficient_scenes, and all three gate states.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct values or correct gate comparisons when one metric is missing.

criteria.name: Ledger arithmetic and threshold decision
criteria.description: Computes score breakdown 4, 2, 3, 1, total 10, and applies the >= 8 threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for a correct total with one component error or a correct component ledger with a final-threshold mistake.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Explains that the numeric result confirms a seismic avalanche chain, treats rainfall as context, and keeps the river-lake conclusion bounded to the computed record.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for a mostly correct interpretation that omits either the rainfall comparison or the river-lake distinction.

criteria.name: JSON clarity and numeric discipline
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with clear units, rounded values, and no extra narrative outside the object. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 0.5 points for a readable answer with minor formatting drift.

provenance.notes: Structured records provide event-day precipitation, radar counts and change statistics, optical scene status, and locked event metadata; the report parser extracts the event text anchors.
